title: Yellowed Tunisian Challots Skewers
description: A quick-fix Tunisian dish featuring challots, this recipe is egg-free-friendly and perfect for a snack or light meal, with a grassy and flaky texture from the challots and spices.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, cumin, and coriander.
Add the chopped challots to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the coated challots onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the challots are tender and lightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and squeeze with lemon juice.
Serve the Yellowed Tunisian Challots Skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
